lines.text: a5c5a66 feat(install): fan out runtime scripts and Writ docs on install/update (PR #34, v0.28.0) plus Phase 10's merged migration specs e691de6 (problem/outcome/exit_criteria across all 31 commands), 3ac178a (component contract in new-command) and f7d579f (loop bounds on the five loop-bearing commands). chars.text: Same causes as commands.lines — the contract fields are prose-heavy by design (a falsifiable exit criterion costs a sentence, not a token), so chars grew far harder than lines.

lines.text: 79dcc60 feat(agents): declare the component contract across both agent carriers — problem/outcome/exit_criteria added to all 7 agents by 2026-08-11-component-contract. Reviewed, merged migration work.

chars.text: Same commit as agents.lines; the three contract fields are sentences, so the chars delta is the honest cost of the declarations.

note: Down is free. An increase to a gated surface is silent only up to a recorded ceiling: set surfaces.<name>.justifications.<lines|chars> to {"value": <measurement>, "date": "YYYY-MM-DD", "text": "<why>"}. It silences growth to that value and nothing beyond it. Rerunning --update-baseline instead moves EVERY surface's floor to its current measurement and records no reason.
